record.label: r63 defect transversality criterion
record.summary: A generic prefix succeeds if every nonzero defect row-space stratum satisfies mu_s < s(s+61)/2+1. The simpler minimum-row-rank-at-least-176 condition is a conservative sufficient corollary and gives sigma1 at least sigma_min(N0) times the defect angle.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved as an incidence theorem, not as a claim that the physical defect space satisfies it.
record.goal_path_summary: Atomic theorem or gate; no sibling inherits this status or evidence.
